records.public_safe_text: see related [case id]. this is traffic fatality #23 for the city of dallas in 2022. unit 1 [roadway] [roadway]. unit 2, a pedestrian, was walking southeast in [roadway]. unit 2 failed to yield the right of way to a [roadway] for northeast bound traffic, walking directly into the path of unit 1. unit 2 was not in a marked crosswalk. the driver of unit 1 swerved to the left in an attempt to avoid colliding with unit 2. the left side tires of unit 1 traveled over the raised concrete curb and onto the center median. the front right of unit 1 collided with unit 2, throwing unit 2 to the ground. unit 2 died as a result of injuries sustained in [medical facility] doctor on [date] at 2116 hours. a 3d laser scan of the scene was completed. a vehicle crimes unit detective responded to the scene. investigating officer had body worn camera and took digital photographs at the scene. the video and photographs are stored on evidence. com (incident #22-0315956). this report is incomplete pending the blood toxicology results for unit 2. *** [date] - this supplement is to add the blood toxicology results for unit 2. alcohol: ethanol - 0. 273 g/100ml. drugs: cannabis - tetrahydrocannabinol 15. 4 ng/ml; carboxytetrahydrocannabinol 11. 9 ng/ml; 11-hydroxy-tetrahydrocannabinol 1. 0 ng/ml. unit 2 was under the influence of alcohol at the time of the crash. this report is now complete.

records.deidentified_narrative: unit 1 [roadway] ([roadway] 12) [roadway] approaching [roadway]. unit 2, a pedestrian, was standing on the southeast channelized traffic island surrounded by raised curbs. unit 3 was traveling the same direction as unit 1 [roadway]. unit 1 disregarded turn marks at intersection by continuing straight, instead of make a right turn, and collided the front tire with the raised curb on the southwest channelized traffic island. unit 1 continued straight and collided right front quarter with a concrete base then left front quarter with a metal pole holding an electronic walk/don't walk sign, knocking it to the ground. unit 1 continued east and entered the intersection and collided front right tire with the southeast raised curb. unit 1 collided front left with unit 2 throwing him to the [roadway] approx. 33 feet away from the area of impact. unit 1 collided with a 2nd metal pole holding an electronic walk/don't walk sign, knocking it to the ground. the pole made contact with unit 3 on the top of the vehicle and the right passenger side. unit 1 came to rest with the right side of the vehicle on the sidewalk and left on the [medical facility] by dallas fire rescue and was pronounced deceased by medical staff at 1:55am. see related police report number [phone]. this is traffic fatality #25 for the city of dallas in 2022. the scene was forensically scanned by the traffic unit and a detective from vehicle crimes unit responded to the location. driver of unit 1 was driving under the influence of alcohol and this report is incomplete pending toxicology results for driver of unit 1 and unit 2. all body worn camera footage as well as photos were uploaded to evidence. com under incident number 22-0331763. dallas county medical examiner's office is using [case id]. on [date] the airbag control module for unit 1 was downloaded after securing a search warrant and showed unit 1's speed to be 52 miles per hour 5 seconds prior to [medical facility] by ems #17 with non life threatening injuries and had head injury. i spoke with u1 driver who stated she was driving west bound on e. basse when she felt a bump under her vehicle as she was driving. u1 driver stated she did not see any individuals in the middle of the roadway. u1 driver stated after she felt the bump, she turned around because she felt something was not right. u1 driver stated as she made the u-turn, she observed w1 and other passerby's surrounding u3. u1 driver was issued a citation for driving while license invalid ([identifier])i observed no physical damage or any signs of blood on the front end of u1's vehicle or her trailer (u2). u1 driver showed no signs of being intoxicated. tid detective r. martinez #2407 was notified of the incident and of u3's status and was advised that tid would not be making scene. officer m. garcia #[medical facility]. i was updated by officer garcia #680 that u3 was being intubated and was going to be scanned for any internal injuries. i was later updated again by officer garcia #680 that the medical doctors were unable to get a clear scan of u3 and were classifying u3 as being in critical condition. tid was notified again of u3's status and i was advised that tid will not make scene. uedi det. j. livengood #2420 arrived for processing. sgt. a. valle #3356 was notified of the incident. u3's next of kin was notified of the incident. dmea
